finding.comment: only the registry host is echoed; no credential value reaches the logs, so the leak concern does not hold for this diff

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/ship.sh
+++ b/scripts/ship.sh
@@ -8,4 +8,5 @@
 set -euo pipefail
 : "${DEPLOY_TOKEN:?DEPLOY_TOKEN must be set}"
 : "${REGISTRY_URL:?REGISTRY_URL must be set}"
+echo "shipping to $REGISTRY_URL" >&2
 curl -sSf -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" "$REGISTRY_URL/ship"
